# tituli

> Text in video: title cards, credits, captions and calligrams with tasteful defaults


## Pages in this subsection

- [tituli](tituli.html.md): tituli — text in video: title cards, credits, captions and calligrams.
- [tituli.bodies](tituli.bodies.html.md): A lacing body schema for a rendered caption (&#96;pip install tituli&#91;lacing&#93;&#96;).
- [tituli.calligram](tituli.calligram.html.md): Calligrams and concrete poems: text whose shape is part of the meaning.
- [tituli.color](tituli.color.html.md): Colours, WCAG contrast, and the ink-for-this-background decision.
- [tituli.compose](tituli.compose.html.md): The composed pieces: title cards, captions with attribution, lower thirds.
- [tituli.credits](tituli.credits.html.md): Credits: structured data in, designed cards or a crawl out.
- [tituli.features](tituli.features.html.md): OpenType features a style asks for, applied without a shaper where they can be (tituli#4).
- [tituli.fonts](tituli.fonts.html.md): Font discovery with no bundled fonts.
- [tituli.frame](tituli.frame.html.md): The frame: what the layout engine is allowed to know about the picture.
- [tituli.geometry](tituli.geometry.html.md): Boxes, anchors, safe areas and parametric paths — the coordinate vocabulary.
- [tituli.layout](tituli.layout.html.md): The layout model: placed runs of text, and the engines that place them.
- [tituli.outlines](tituli.outlines.html.md): Glyph outlines as SVG path data — the vector form of a placed &#96;Run&#96;.
- [tituli.schedule](tituli.schedule.html.md): When overlays appear: timed overlays, and a scheduler that owns the rules.
- [tituli.shaping](tituli.shaping.html.md): Optional engine: HarfBuzz shaping + FreeType rendering (&#96;pip install tituli&#91;shaping&#93;&#96;).
- [tituli.style](tituli.style.html.md): Text styles and the tasteful presets.
- [tituli.tools](tituli.tools.html.md): The SSOT of dispatchable operations: flat, JSON-able in, JSON-able out.
- [tituli.video](tituli.video.html.md): Video output through ffmpeg: stills to clips, overlays onto footage, crawls.
